relationship_to_reform_v2.rule: Office v2 classes answer where/how state lives and ages. Reform v2 categories answer semantic authority/proof role. Neither silently replaces the other.

classes.authority: continuation/index scope only; references domain truth
never current truth by event existence alone
classes.promotion_rule: A referenced observation may serve as EVIDENCE_RECEIPT; the event does not become an effect authority.
Exact digest may be referenced as EVIDENCE_RECEIPT.

classes.authority: projection only; source must be re-resolved for authoritative claims/effects

legacy_migration_rule: Existing repo-hosted operational state from Reform v2 remains authoritative exactly as currently declared until a later gated migration. Phase 0 forbids adding new live state to Git and records candidates; it does not cut over existing owners.
